messages:
erin: FYI noticed customer ticket where usage shows the SA owner project instead of the frontend project that minted the exchange token. They got billed incorrectly.
sam: Can you paste a minimal repro? headers + token?
erin: Sure: ```
POST /v1/chat
Authorization: Bearer exch-8f7a
X-Delegated-Project: proj-frontend
X-Req-ID: r-555
```
erin: Dashboard credit shows project: sa-owner-project instead of proj-frontend.
leo: Historically router used token principal for billing to avoid trusting headers. But exchange tokens now include a signed claim `delegated_project` when minted. Router just isn’t reading it for SA-derived tokens.
maya: This is causing bad noise for teams with strict budgets. We should avoid a sudden default change that moves bills across projects.
sam: Proposal: implement a reconciliation step: if exchange token proof verifies, prefer `delegated_project`. Otherwise fallback to token-owner. Keep behind FF + org opt-in.
erin: Telemetry first: emit `auth.attribution.reconciled` (true/false), `auth.attribution.source` (exchange|header|token), and `auth.delegated_tokens_seen`. Tag by org and route.
leo: Also add a short audit line per request when FF enabled: `resolved_attribution=proj-frontend,source=exchange,verified=true` (sparse, no PII). Retain 30d behind the flag.
sam: UX: console should show both values side-by-side — "Requested" vs "Resolved billing" — with a one-line explanation. Add an org toggle called "Attribution reconciliation: token-owner (default) | delegated-first".
maya: Legal/sales flagged that some contracts assume owner-project billing. Keep opt-in default. If an org flips, we should notify account lead.
erin: Rollout suggestion: 14 days telemetry, 3 pilot orgs (opt-in), 1% canary traffic, then 10% after 2 weeks, monitor billing deltas.
sam: Dev tasks: (1) metrics + audit payload behind FF, (2) router resolver change behind FF, (3) console API & columns + org toggle. Split into small PRs.
leo: Add unit/integration tests for tampered exchange tokens — only accept `delegated_project` when `proof_verified=true`.
ops-bot: Ticket INFRA-4010 created: attribution reconciliation + telemetry + org opt-in toggle (FF + 30d audit retention).
tara: I'll draft quick dashboard panels highlighting mismatch by org and a migration snippet for billing ETL: `resolved_attribution: project=proj-frontend,source=exchange,verified=true`.
erin: Great. Once dashboards show low-risk numbers we'll coordinate outreach. No immediate release blocker.
maya: I’ll notify account leads for customers that reported spikes.
sam: Thanks all. Please post PR links here when ready and label them `attribution-recon`.
